thread:
samir: Morning — quick triage pulse. Queue at 18 open tickets (was 13 yesterday). Most are low-touch billing/usage questions but we have a cluster of embeddings failures causing 4 active tickets from three customers. 

maria: Thanks. Do we know root cause for the embeddings ones? Error looks like 502 from the embed service.

samir: Repro is showing intermittent timeouts on the dedicated embed pool when batch size > 64. Seen increased latencies after last night's deploy. Stacktrace from user logs: 

```
2026-03-17T06:11:22Z ERROR embed-service request failed status=502 latency=1203ms batch_size=128
```

devon: I added an incident note and pinned the two public tickets. I also rolled the embed model pool back to the previous variant 1.2.3 in staging. Need ops to confirm prod rollback. :wrench:

alex: On it — starting a controlled rollback now. Will monitor 10 mins then update.

support-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback started by alex for resource embed-pool-prod (rollout id r-88a7). ETA ~4m.

maria: For responses, please use the new macro: `embed-timeout-apology_v2` — it mentions the degraded performance, steps we took (rollback), and a private support link for logs. Short macro, then add personalized ETA.

samir: +1 on macro. Also small heads-up: ticket 9421 is asking for a partial refund due to 2-hour outage window. Use refund macro `support-refund-lite` then escalate to @devon for approval.

devon: A few asks: 
- Can we get a quick list of tickets that need engineering attention beyond the embeddings ones?
- Any CRs blocking triage?

alex: From my scan — 3 tickets flagged as internal-bug (attachments failing on uploads), one is flaky on an old SDK version. I left a comment on the SDK ticket asking for repro steps.

samir: For the engineering list, I exported a filtered search and pasted the links in the channel thread (below). Use the standard triage label workflow: `triage/needs-eng` then add priority.

samir: Link dump: https://redwood.company/support/search?query=triage%2Fneeds-eng%20status%3Aopen

maria: Rotation note — I'll cover first half of the day, @alex takes the afternoon. If rollback stabilizes, we can move embeddings tickets to P1->P2 in the tracker.

alex: Rollback finished, error rate dropping to baseline in the last 6m. Monitoring for 15 more. If stable, I'll close the incident note.

support-bot: [monitor] embed-pool-prod error_rate: 2.1% -> 0.6% (6m window).

samir: Nice. Action items: 
- maria: apply `embed-timeout-apology_v2` macro to the 4 embedding tickets and add ETA (we expect full resolution in 2 hours).
- devon: approve refunds for any customers who request credits (ticket 9421 flagged).
- alex: confirm prod metrics are green and post final status.
- everyone: quick scan for any other `triage/needs-eng` tickets and flag anything urgent.

maria: Will do. Also updated the macros doc with a short usage example for the new macro: 

```
Macro: embed-timeout-apology_v2
Use: Explains degraded embedding throughput, notes rollback, links to support portal, offers workaround (smaller batch sizes)
Snippet to paste: "We're sorry for the degraded embedding performance. We've rolled back a recent change and are monitoring — in the meantime, reducing batch sizes to <=64 is a workable mitigation. We expect full remediation within ~2 hours. If you'd like, we can apply a temporary quota bump to help catch up."
```

devon: Heads-up — there's a small PR blocking release that touches the upload path (might be related to attachments failing). @alex can you review #5284 today? It's short.

alex: On my list after monitoring stabilizes. Ping me again in 20 if I forget.

samir: Thanks team. If anything else pops up, drop it here. Otherwise I'll post a short follow-up once the embedding tickets have the macro applied and refunds sorted. :thumbsup:

maria: Applied macro to all 4 embedding tickets and added personalized ETAs. Marking two as awaiting-customer for confirmation.

alex: Metrics stable for 20m, closing incident note.

support-bot: [auto-note] incident closed by alex at 2026-03-17T07:20:00Z.

samir: Follow-up: total triage volume for today = 18, escalated to engineering = 4, refunds requested = 1. Closing this standup thread.

maria: Thanks — nice quick recovery.

devon: Great job.

alex: :clap:
